### sensors_b.csv

- **temperature:** (19.8 + 20.2 + 20.5 + 20.1) / 4 = 20.150
- **humidity:** (45.2 + 44.7 + 45.9 + 46.3) / 4 = 45.525

### sensors_c.csv

- **pressure:** (1012.3 + 1011.8 + 1012.9 + 1013.4 + 1012.7 + 1012.1) / 6 = 1012.533
